parameters.help_en:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **Oracle**
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下：
- **MySQL**
- **Oracle**
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. You can specify only one database name.

> This parameter is supported only for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle Compatible) clusters
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，只支持传入一个数据库名称。

> 仅PolarDB PostgreSQL（兼容Oracle）版集群支持该参数
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source instance
parameters.name: source_db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the destination database engine.

- Valid values for MySQL:

  - **5.6**

  - **5.7**

  - **8.0**

- Valid value for Oracle: **14**
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库引擎版本号。
* MySQL版本号取值范围如下： 
    * **5.6**
    * **5.7**
    * **8.0**
* Oracle版本号取值为**14**
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en:
The creation method. Valid values:

- **MigrationFromRDS**: Migrate data from an existing RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. The created PolarDB cluster is in read-only mode and has binary logging enabled by default. For operations in the console, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html.

- **UpgradeFromPolarDB**: Upgrade and migrate data from a PolarDB cluster. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建方式，取值范围如下： 

* **MigrationFromRDS**：从现有RDS实例迁移数据到新的PolarDB集群。创建的PolarDB集群是只读模式，且默认开启Binlog。控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html。

* **UpgradeFromPolarDB**：从PolarDB升级迁移，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html
parameters.name: creation_option

parameters.help_en:
The product series. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Cluster Edition (default)

- **SENormal**: Standard Edition

See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.help_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：
* **Normal**：集群版（默认值）
* **SENormal**：标准版

更多关产品系列的介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.name: creation_category
